alternate_names: Shri Mata Durga Bhavani Bada Temple Karnal

history.summary: A Shakti temple at Shakti Colony, near the Karnal bus stand, known for its ornate golden gate and architecture. One listings site calls it the oldest temple of Karnal, but no founding date, builder, or historical source is published (verify). The temple is serene and popular during Navratri, when the nine nights of the Mother Goddess are celebrated with processions and Dussehra festivities.

name: Shri Mata Durga Bhavani Bada Mandir
town_description: Karnal is a historic city in eastern Haryana on the Grand Trunk Road, traditionally associated with Karna of the Mahabharata and said to have been founded as Karnalaya by him. It is a major centre of agricultural research, hosting the National Dairy Research Institute, the Central Soil Salinity Research Institute, and the National Bureau of Animal Genetic Resources. The city is also the hometown of astronaut Kalpana Chawla, memorialised at the Kalpana Chawla Memorial Planetarium.

travel.airport: Chandigarh International Airport, about 125-130 km (verify); Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, about 130 km (verify).
travel.railway: Karnal Junction railway station, about 2-3 km away (verify); the temple is near the Karnal bus stand in Shakti Colony.
travel.road: On Ambedkar Marg near Karan Park Market, Shakti Colony, within Karnal city; accessible by local transport.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Navratri (September-October) is the most festive period
